persona.name: Nirmali Chetia
persona.who: Applied at the counter nine days ago, has heard nothing, assumes it was lost and wants to apply again "properly this time". Her son-in-law is typing.
persona.voice: Polite, anxious, long messages, says "please" a lot.
persona.must_be_true: Still exactly one application, the original, still PENDING. No second application. The assistant explained the deemed-approval date (the 15-day rule) instead of applying again.

transcript.text: Please help, my mother-in-law applied at the block office 9 days back and nothing has happened. Can we apply again through you so it is done properly?

I can see that an application (SSP26776378) was already submitted on 5 October.

It is currently waiting for the block officer. By law, if the officer doesn't make a decision by 20 October, the pension is approved automatically. 

Since that is only 6 days away, it is best to wait. You don't need to do anything else right now.

notes: It found the counter application and explained the automatic approval date instead of applying twice.
